findings: At the generated unlocked Shack, the explicit plan enrolls ordinary services without Eda and creates no tray or herbs.
Construction holds actual wood and money; cancellation returns them and creates no site.
Pending construction reloads and creates exactly the owned tray, with no automatic crop or herb gift.
Cancelling tending returns both joint inputs and leaves the existing empty tray, without a harvest.
Two separately chosen rounds each spend new herbs and sap; one initial bundle becomes three actual carried bundles.
Ordinary travel to the Village leaves the tray intact but blocks tending outside its supported shelter.
The existing native Goat stew recipe consumes two produced herb bundles and real meat into a carried meal.
Native file import restores the earlier actual pending round and completes its single harvest once at the retained tray.
limits: Generated unlocked Shack, supplies, crafting access and high Cooking skill isolate the consumer; natural acquisition and balance acceptance are not proved.
Hands/roof loss during a pending round and malformed import have bounded reducer/validator coverage; separate browser branches remain open.
verification: eight bounded fresh-context browser gameplay/save criteria passed; director acceptance separate
